final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating AS rating, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM film_category AS fc JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = fc.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS record_total FROM rating_counts), shares AS (SELECT rc.rating, rc.record_count, CAST(rc.record_count AS REAL) / t.record_total AS share FROM rating_counts AS rc JOIN total AS t ON t.record_total IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.rating, s.record_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_average FROM shares AS s JOIN average_share AS a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.rating
